candidates.description: This feature vector represents common phonetic endings, syllables, and place-name components frequently found in Mandarin Chinese Romanization (Pinyin).
This feature vector represents the prefix 'Est-' and its common linguistic variations across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on terms and roots related to armed conflict, military forces, and warfare across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to proper nouns and historical figures, particularly prominent political leaders and figures from the 20th century.
This vector represents words or word fragments containing the letters "ass" (case-insensitive) in various linguistic contexts.
This feature vector represents words related to specific European and Mediterranean countries, nationalities, and major cities.
This feature vector represents the character sequence 'ap' or 'jap' within various words, names, and roots.
This vector represents common Basque verbal suffixes and inflectional endings.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens related to violence, crime, and acts of aggression.
This vector activates for words, stems, and proper nouns related to governance, authority, and official systems, frequently led by the root string "reg".
